purpose: Every enabled project in settings/wake/projects.json gets at least one real, claimable ledger item, so a woken shift claims real work instead of getting `nothing-todo`. The authority's ledger was measured empty on 2026-10-13 (`python3 /root/bin/work.py list` => `no items`).

item_schema.title: one line
item_schema.dod: a command whose output proves it (the shift quotes the output)

items.title: Kosher server: add an unauthenticated /readyz that distinguishes process-up from DB-writable
items.dod: Apply settings/wake/kosher-advance/0001-readyz.patch to a pristine kosher-filter-ai checkout at 26da13f2 (or Mac 3cc0330) and run `cd server && python3 -m pytest tests/test_health_readiness.py -q`: it must print a pass summary. Before the patch, `/readyz` is absent from app.routes; after, it returns 200 with the DB reachable and 503 when the DB write probe fails, while `/health?deep=true` stays auth-gated (401). Quote both the route diff and the pytest summary.
items.why: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_BACKLOG.md (2026-09-14 audit) lists 'No readiness endpoint (/health?deep=true is auth-gated; verified 401 live), so "process up" and "database writable" are indistinguishable to an orchestrator'. The wake loop needs exactly that distinction.

items.title: LPT website: fast-forward the checkout to origin/test and record the exact commit delta
items.dod: On the build host run `git -C <phone-and-tech-full> fetch origin`, `git -C <phone-and-tech-full> rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`, `git -C <phone-and-tech-full> rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/test`, then `git merge --ff-only origin/test` if behind, and `git status --porcelain`. The ledger attempt must contain all four outputs verbatim. TEST ONLY; never deploy to production.
items.why: The 2026-09-28 correction recorded this checkout 426 commits behind origin/test behind a stale index.lock; distance is unmeasured today.

items.title: LPT sync: name and run the entrypoint for each leg of the Dialpad -> lpt-hub -> prod -> website chain
items.dod: In C:\Users\ezabz\Code\lpt-hub, locate the sync entrypoints (`git grep -n -i 'dialpad' -- '*.js' '*.ts' '*.py' '*.mjs'`), then run the safest read-only status command for each leg (e.g. `--help`, `--dry-run`, or a status subcommand) and quote every command with its exit code and first output lines. If a leg has no runnable entrypoint, that is the finding and it is filed as its own item.

items.title: Production DB: measure size, WAL size and newest row timestamp read-only, and record the freshness verdict
items.dod: On the authority run a read-only probe (e.g. `ls -l /root/authority.db*` plus `sqlite3 'file:/root/authority.db?mode=ro' "SELECT max(created_at) FROM ...;"` for one real table, or the repo's own freshness tool). Quote the command and output. Do NOT run dbstat, a full scan or a write anywhere.
items.why: The authoritative DB is the company's single source of truth; size, truth and freshness are all open and the last size (12.37 GB) is old.

items.title: Housekeeping: prove whether scripts/deployed/bin/sources matches the live /root/bin/sources
items.dod: Run a hash comparison, e.g. `for f in ledger-keepalive.py project-keepalive.py roadmap-supply.py projects.json checkout-health.py; do sha256sum <repo>/scripts/deployed/bin/sources/$f /root/bin/sources/$f; done`, and quote every line. Any mismatch is either synced (with the mirror commit recorded) or filed as its own item with this command as the before-proof.
items.why: The 2026-10-12 cutover left the wake loop unscheduled; a silent mirror/live divergence is exactly the class of failure that made projects stop advancing.
